outfit.name: 武陵白绿分袖中式衣装
outfit.prose: Her white-and-celadon sleeveless Chinese-style top has a dark high neckline and black waist harness, with detached black-and-white sleeves, black gloves, a layered belt, wide green trousers with pale upper panels and dark patterned hems, and black boots.
